resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the cab is now gone. The Rex's page says a private party bought it and moved it. The Forest Fire Lookout Association says it was sold and removed to a private cabin about 20 miles southeast of Joseph. The story reports all three and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Only three pages describe this site, and they agree on the 1953 cab but not on its fate. No construction, staffing or fire history in any source. The 1970s emergency use is in the story but not an event, since the register gives only the decade. Access is not stated; no access key. Do not confuse with Frazier Mountain in Ventura County, California. Coordinates differ: register 45.07619, -117.69498; FFLOS list 45.07974, -117.69300. The brief's record matches the register. No photos added: no image URLs captured.
